card.name: Partway through rare long words
card.fires_on: Short word pieces in the middle of a longer, rare word, such as the 'ib' in kinase-inhibitor drug names, the 'B' in EXACERBATION, or a vowel in Lao script.

modes.label: Drug name endings
modes.description: The 'ib' piece inside a kinase inhibitor name, before the word is finished.
modes.example: ministration of gilteritin<<ib>> may increase the exposure of P-gp

modes.label: Split warning word
modes.description: The 'B' piece inside the word EXACERBATION in a hepatitis B warning.
modes.example: WARNING: POST TREATMENT ACUTE EXACER<<B>>ATION OF HEPATITIS B

modes.label: Lao script
modes.description: A single Lao vowel character in the middle of a word in the Lao motto.
modes.example: ສັນຕິພາບ ເ<<ອ>>ກະລາດ ປ
